_readme: Times (updated, date) are UTC in this file; the page shows them in CEST. Source for the three-track results page. Add a row to `results` whenever a score lands, then run `python scripts/build_tracks_page.py` (writes results/tracks/index.html). Scores from runs/baselines/*/*/summary.json and results/**/summary.json are picked up automatically. eval: headline = held-out May 2023-2026 papers with a judge (240 pts); headline-auto = same papers, auto-scorable items only, no judge; contaminated = older papers (matura_all.jsonl), also used for training; dev = not the matura (MCQ sets, practice geography). No IPs, tokens or account IDs here.

tracks.name: Best matura score
tracks.goal: Highest final exam result with a base of at most 8.0 GB and a trained model of at most 8.8 GB on disk.
tracks.status: Head-to-head of Bielik-11B v2.3, Bielik-11B v3 AWQ, Gemma-4-12B QAT and Qwen3.5-9B with a local judge is queued for the shared L40S. The exam sends real pictures (85 of 154 held-out items), so vision-capable bases are now in scope.
next: Run score-shootout on the held-out papers with the Qwen3-14B-AWQ judge
Decide the GGUF serving path (llama.cpp in serve_exam.sh or an AWQ build) before Gemma-4 or Qwen3.5 can be the exam model
Retarget DAPT and SFT to the winning base
blockers: HF_TOKEN in Forgehand Secrets to train the gated bf16 Bielik v3

tracks.name: Best progress
tracks.goal: Largest gain of the trained model over the untouched base model, both scored the same way.
tracks.status: Proposed base is the pretrained, non-chat Bielik-11B-v2 (about 6.7 GB in NF4): weak raw, strong once we do DAPT, SFT and RAG ourselves. 953 Claude-written training items are on main. Raw base eval, DAPT and SFT are queued behind the GPU.
next: Score the untouched Bielik-11B-v2 raw on the held-out papers (progress-base-raw)
DAPT on the filtered Polish history corpus (progress-dapt)
SFT with past papers and synthetic items, then raw/routed/adapters/rag evals (progress-sft)
blockers: Organisers: one base/trained pair per team for all prizes, or one per prize?

candidates.note: base currently registered on the site

tracks.name: Mały, ale wariat
tracks.goal: Smallest model on disk that scores at least 35%.
tracks.status: Nine tiny models (270M to 4.6B) are scoring on the shared GPU, raw and routed; Qwen3-0.6B is also scoring on CPU. A Wikipedia knowledge base for RAG is being built. The earlier Qwen2.5-7B AWQ 37.6% was only the unverified auto-scored 70-point subset and does not prove a ≥35% graded official mock; the Claude-graded official mock for that pack is 18.3%, Bielik-4.5B FP8 reached 40.0%, and the new honest Qwen2.5-0.5B / 1.5B Claude rows landed at 5.0% and 6.7%, so sub-2B is still far below the bar.
next: Finish small-baselines and rank by size
Boost the best tiny model with RAG, SFT and prompt tricks
Try small vision models (Gemma-3-4B, Qwen2.5-VL-3B) since the exam sends pictures
